QUOTE: "The library creates no threads. The only pthread wiring is in `programs/Makefile` (`THREADING=pthread`), which affects the sample programs, not the library."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads, but it doesn't say that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading.c) for threaded callers. It describes threading.c only as disabled by default and makes no mention of that abstraction.
